name: Claude Code /doctor (v2.1.205)
hook: Upgraded in Week 28 (v2.1.205): /doctor is now a full interactive setup checkup, not a read-only report. It checks installation health, surfaces unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins alongside their per-session context cost, deduplicates local CLAUDE.md content against the checked-in version, proposes trimming CLAUDE.md sections Claude could derive from the codebase, and flags slow hooks. Reports findings first and asks for confirmation before changing anything. Also available as /checkup.
